faq.q: What is the origin of Adilah?
faq.a: Adilah is associated with Arabic. Variant romanization of عديلة.
Yes — the underlying form عديلة is Arabic.
Adilah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Adilah should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. root ع د ل occurs in the Qur'an; عديلة is a normal Arabic feminine form

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
